The Subtask Name: Determine the nickname of Bangor, Maine

- Agent: WebSurfer

- Agent: Planner

  -- Thought: Open the Wikipedia page for Bangor, Maine to confirm the exact nickname listed in the infobox.
  -- Result: Decided to engage WebSurfer to open the Wikipedia URL.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Navigated to the Wikipedia page for Bangor, Maine and inspected the content.
  -- Observation: Found the infobox explicitly stating "Nickname: Gateway to the North" and the text stating "Bangor is known as the 'Queen City'".
  -- Thought: Both nicknames are present; "The Queen City" is mentioned in the text as the common name, while "Gateway to the North" is in the infobox.
  -- Result: Confirmed both nicknames: "The Queen City" and "Gateway to the North".
